The lady trying AI tools randomly, getting errors, escalation emails popping on screen, boss shouting on video call, she holding her head in frustration. Suddenly, a notification pops up on her phone: 'Social Eagle AI Community – Learn AI Smartly.' Scene brightens instantly.
